title: Hypha worked-example index
description: Every worked example a release ships, by the name of its page. Generated by tools/knowledge-gen into knowledge/<tag>/textual-notation/examples/index.json, next to the pages.

tag.description: The release the models were read from.

examples.description: Keyed by the page's file name without .md, such as kerml-src-examples-behavior-examples-camera: the name in the example's hypha://<tag>/examples/<name> address. Ordered by key.

name.description: The model's own name: its file name without the extension.

source.description: The model's path relative to the release's textual sources, /-separated.

elements.description: The metaclasses the model declares, ordered ordinally, as its page lists them.
